tables.name: s73_homemark_H16M10
tables.purpose: sub-second two-colour partial: HOME (pale yellow, slot 1 = border) K16 0x6 S16; MARK (navy, slot 5) S10 K10; every other code empty = hold
tables.measured_result: BUSY 0.935 s; 100 updates with no stock refresh, home/mark cells drift no more than an untouched control strip (slopes 0.002/0.008 dE00 per update); home/mark contrast 55-65 dE00
tables.origin: from-scratch (our synthetic segments; no stock rows)
tables.header_note: header bytes 1-6 carry the rail/VCOM/rate codes of the stock set our lab used as a template; custom mode ignores the header (rails come from PWR, VCOM from VDCS, frame rate from PLL), so you may overwrite them with your own set's header bytes
